Semiconductors sit at the intersection of technology, economics, national security, trade, and industrial policy. This page brings together my work on chip supply chains, India's semiconductor strategy, fabrication and packaging, and the geopolitics of technological interdependence.

::: {.topic-hero}
::: {.topic-hero-card}
### Start here

[*When the Chips Are Down: A Deep Dive into a Global Crisis*](../books.qmd#when-the-chips-are-down-a-deep-dive-into-a-global-crisis) explains how semiconductors became a meta-critical technology and why chip supply chains now shape geopolitics.
:::

The [India Semiconductor Manufacturing Tracker](https://fabs.pranaykotas.com) monitors India's fabs, ATMP/OSAT units, compound semiconductor projects, milestones, investment, slippage, and technical complexity.

## Core Questions

- What should India's semiconductor strategy prioritise: leading-edge fabs, mature nodes, packaging, design, equipment, or talent?
- How can countries reduce asymmetric dependence in chip supply chains without falling into technology autarky?
- What does semiconductor manufacturing reveal about state capacity, industrial policy, and global technology alliances?
- How should India work with partners such as the US, Japan, Taiwan, Australia, and the EU?
